name: alternate-bent-over-dumbbell-reverse-fly.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the exercise by grasping a pair of dumbbells with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and standing with your feet around shoulder width apart.
2. Bend slightly at the knees and bring your torso forward by bending at the waist.
3. Each elbow should be slightly bent and the dumbbells should be directly under your chest. This is the starting position.
4. Take a deep breath and raise one dumbbell towards the ceiling in a semi-circular motion using the rear deltoids, until your arm is parallel to the floor.
5. Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position under control.
6. Immediately repeat the movement with your opposite arm. This is one rep.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
